pr_title: Show the most recent log entries on the status page

comments.comment: recentErrors takes the last count entries with slice(-count), which returns every entry for count 0, the value that hides the section. One of three instances of one shape in this change.
comments.failureScenario: recentErrors(log, 0) evaluates slice(-0), which is slice(0), and returns every entry rather than none, so a viewer who set the section to 0 to hide it sees the error history. It is one of three readers with this shape; recentMessages in src/messages.ts and recentWarnings in src/warnings.ts fail the same way.

comments.comment: recentMessages takes the last count entries with slice(-count), which returns every entry for count 0, the value that hides the section. One of three instances of one shape in this change.
comments.failureScenario: recentMessages(log, 0) evaluates slice(-0), which is slice(0), and returns every entry rather than none, so a viewer who set the section to 0 to hide it sees the whole log. It is one of three readers with this shape; recentErrors in src/errors.ts and recentWarnings in src/warnings.ts fail the same way.
